sermon.title: Father’s Day — June 19, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A faithful father shares about seeking God’s house and adjusting our course. Six rules for life from Moses follow: work hard, turn aside to God, bring questions to Him, make no excuses, trust He is with you and obey. Prayer for fathers closes the service.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Sharing begins at 20:27 after worship.

chunks.short_answer: Adjust your course often by the scriptures, like a navigator, and discipline the body.
chunks.text:
And the lesson I want to learn is that we need to adjust our position we need to adjust our heart. To God’s. We need to adjust the course in our life. And uh. I often think of it as a journey on a ship on the ocean. I have a friend who uh grew up on hawaii an island thousands of miles out to sea. And back in the 60s. He got on a sailboat and him and a couple of buddies sailed that sailboat from hawaii all the way to the west coast here. And if you’re familiar with the americas.

If you head towards the rising sun it would be tough to miss America. He he wasn’t sure they were running low they were out of food they were running low on water. Weeks into the trip. They knew they were heading in the right direction but they didn’t know where they were. And a freighter came by. And saw this sailboat hundreds of miles out to sea and they stopped and they gave them a big pot of stew and all the water they could carry and they told them they were only a few miles away. A few hundred miles away I should say. And so they knew that that they were gonna make it and of course they got their boat to America.

But if you’re going the other way. You gotta you gotta keep your course straight as an arrow. Got to get the right course you have to adjust often the wind changes direction. The waves change direction. You can be buffeted and you got to check your position you gotta chart your course you gotta check the stars you gotta head the right direction or you’re gonna miss hawaii. By hundreds of miles you’ll never see it. And you won’t make it. And that’s what we need to do. We need to get up every morning. And we need to dwell in the house of the Lord we’ve got to calm our spirits.

And look to the scriptures. And we need to chart our course and adjust our course. And we need to do it often if you don’t do it often you’re going to be going way off course and you’re going to be adjusting your course by great degree. And it’s going to be a lot harder to get where you’re going and you might not make it. In Romans chapter 7. Says for I know. That in me that is in my flesh nothing good dwells. Your body. Isn’t bad and it’s not good it’s just a body it’s just a building like this building that we’re in.

And it has needs you’re going to get hungry and food is going to be a real important part of your life. Water your body is gonna. Is gonna influence you to get what it wants. And if we listen to our flesh too much if we put too much emphasis in. The building. We’re going to miss the mark we need to be setting our course. For our temple to be God’s temple. Nothing good dwells in the flesh nothing bad but our flesh can. Mislead us terribly for to will is present with me.

But how to perform what is good I do not find that in my body. For the good that I will to do I do not do. I always want to eat another breakfast burrito. And that’s not necessarily what my body needs. You always want another cookie. Or another your your body is like that was good that was a good cookie get another one and if we follow that we’re gonna have trouble in our lives. But the evil that I will not to do that I practice a lot of times I eat that extra breed or the extra cookie. Now if I do what I will not to do it is no longer I who do it but sin that dwells in me.

chunks.short_answer: A time for everything—time to die, time to heal—so see the hurting and do what’s right anyway.
chunks.text:
So I need to bring my body. And I need to discipline it and I need to quiet my spirit and seek God with this body. In Ecclesiastes chapter 3 verses 1 through 8 to everything there is a season. A time for every purpose under heaven. And it has a whole lot of things that you can do. Some of them look like really good things. Some of them look like really bad things but the Bible says that to everything there is a time. And we need to adjust our course so we’re doing what we’re supposed to do. Of course the first one is a time to be born yes we are born.

And there’s a time to die and being born oh that’s a good thing a time to die well that’s a bad thing but everybody that’s ever lived in this life. Has passed on. That’s part of life it’s proper now if you’re young. Of course it’s not right. If you’re old it’s much more common. Okay there’s a whole lot of other things here. Some of them. A time to kill. Goodness gracious a time to kill it’s in the ten commandments. How can there be a time to kill. Even a tragedy like killing when it’s time if you’re a soldier and you’re in a war.

There’s a time for that. Much more common is a time to heal. We need to look around us and we need to see people that are hurting. People that are dying and we need to help them. Heaven forbid. If we ever have get put in the position if we’re ever in a position where it’s time to kill God help us. But. Even the seemingly tragic things. If we don’t do what we’re supposed to be doing. Terrible things would happen. If the soldiers don’t carry out their grim task what will become of their country. To everything there is a season a time and a purpose under heaven and we need to rise every day and seek God and what he has for us and things that we may not want to do.

We need to do what’s right anyways. And things that we want to do can be tragically wrong if we just do what we want to do. So that’s my life lesson for today. I want us all to every day every the Bible says pray without ceasing ask God to help you to do what’s right in all situations. Thank you for your time. You guys hear that then I may dwell in the house of the Lord amen.

scriptures.text_nkjv: To everything there is a season, A time for every purpose under heaven: A time to be born, And a time to die; A time to plant, And a time to pluck what is planted; A time to kill, And a time to heal; A time to break down, And a time to build up; A time to weep, And a time to laugh; A time to mourn, And a time to dance; A time to cast away stones, And a time to gather stones; A time to embrace, And a time to refrain from embracing; A time to gain, And a time to lose; A time to keep, And a time to throw away; A time to tear, And a time to sew; A time to keep silence, And a time to speak; A time to love, And a time to hate; A time of war, And a time of peace.
